articles.title: RunningTab: Direct Workspace Interaction with Environment-Side Tabs
articles.excerpt: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. articles.summary: 面向工作区知识工作，RunningTab 让 LLM 智能体通过终端直接与已有文件语料交互，无需索引即可搜索、读取，并借助环境侧标签（tabs）组织多文件产出，从而高效生成交付物，核心是把检索与产出都放在环境侧完成，减少索引与上下文开销。

articles.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
articles.excerpt: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. articles.summary: 提出仿真测试床 RobotWorld，用于评测多模态智能体把代码编写、工具调用等数字能力迁移到机器人操作的程度。基准覆盖多样任务与不同本体形态，通过指令与观测驱动的交互，考察通用智能体在物理世界中的可用性。

articles.title: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It

articles.title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis

articles.title: Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching

articles.title: MIMESIS: Learning User Simulators as Training Environments for Interactive Agents

articles.title: From Pareto to Preference: Personalized Test-Time Scaling via Amortized Agentic Policy Discovery

articles.title: QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
